title: Lay the First Yard
description: Raise a Timber Yard to start the settlement.
hint: The Timber Yard is in the Production group.

title: Raise a Watch
description: Build a Watch Tower to guard the approach.
hint: Watch Towers belong to the Defense group.

title: Muster a Guard
description: Train a Shield Guard from the Bunkhouse.
hint: The Bunkhouse trains support and army units.
